page.overview:
Who is Harry Cane?

Harry Cane, also known as Billy Speed, is an Adventurers minifigure introduced in 1998. He makes appearances in the Egypt and Jungle sub-themes.

Harry Cane has black legs, and an earth orange torso printed with an aviator's jacket. His arms are earth orange, and his hands and head are bright yellow. His face has a smirking expression, a black moustache, stubble, and sideburns. He wears an earth orange aviator's helmet with black goggles.

In 5784 Soccer Mania, Billy Speed has grey pants instead of black.

Compared to other Adventurers Egypt characters, Harry Cane's name is one of the most consistent across different markets, regions, and publications. However, there are still a few instances where his name is changed.
